name: 鎏金缎面丝滑身体乳款
description: 以暖金缎面与细金线图鉴串起的身体乳详情套组，从肌理痛点到收口共十一镜

styleLock.direction: warm prestige body-care commerce with gilded satin-ribbon styling and hairline keyline framing
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6 with one thin rose-gold #C99277 keyline frame, alternating with apricot satin drape #F1E2CB and honey board #E8D8BE, closing on a single deep cocoa band #4A3220; one poured amber-gold #B8813B ribbon sweep and one open ring halo recur as the connective motif
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright warm high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, one skimming accent reserved for texture and metal, soft contact shadows only, never harsh hotspots and never a cool cast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: honey-toned matte surface board #E8D8BE and ivory lacquer tabletop #FAF3E6, both with a fine even grain and a soft contact shadow where the product rests
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Latin paired with one humanist Chinese sans, single family only; headline weight in deep cocoa #4A3220, hairline rules and small caps in amber-gold #B8813B, all in-image wording supplied through placeholders rather than copied text
styleLock.iconSystem: hollow single-weight ring outlines and hairline rounded capsule slots in rose-gold #C99277, no filled pictograms, no medals, no check shields, no certification artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: the bottle is always upright at one stable scale with its carton kept to one side or left out entirely, never overlapped by props, never resized between shots; the ring halo and ribbon sweep always sit behind the product
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond the amber-gold and rose-gold pair
no mixed fonts, no serif, no script and no handwritten lettering
no cool grey or blue cast on any field, tabletop or highlight
no photographic room clutter, no real signage and no scenery outside the four stated fields
no filled pictogram icons, awards, seals or certification artwork
no change in bottle scale, upright stance or carton placement between shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm prestige body-care commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory field #FAF3E6, apricot satin drape #F1E2CB, honey surface board #E8D8BE, amber-gold ribbon and hairlines #B8813B, rose-gold ring outlines #C99277 and deep cocoa type #4A3220; warm temperature throughout, never a cool grey or blue cast; bright warm high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, one skimming accent reserved for texture and metal, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one humanist Chinese sans, single family only; hollow thin-line ring badges and hairline rounded capsule slots as the only graphic components; product always upright at one stable scale with the carton kept to one side and never overlapped by props; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no photographic room clutter, no filled pictograms or certification artwork.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击，用暖象牙细金框把泵瓶与外盒干净地立起来。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tall bottle upright beside its rectangular carton, both units fully inside frame
shots.lighting: bright warm high-key front-left softbox key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both units
shots.background: seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6 with one thin rose-gold #C99277 keyline frame inset from the edges
shots.whitespace: even generous margin held between the keyline frame and the product pair
shots.promptTemplate: Packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with the tall upright bottle standing beside its rectangular carton, both units fully inside the frame and neither clipped by the edge. Bright warm high-key studio lighting from a front-left softbox with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both units so nothing floats. Seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6 with one thin rose-gold #C99277 keyline frame inset from the edges and no other set dressing. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with even generous margins kept inside the keyline. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no faces, no floral sprigs, no watermark, no added wording beyond the product's own label, no cool grey cast, no hard-edged shadow, no floating product, no cut-off edges, no text blocks.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则：用倾倒的鎏金缎带与空心环辉把首要利益一次讲完。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle with the product low and left, one open ring halo floating behind it
shots.lighting: soft warm key from the upper left, gentle rim along one edge, soft contact shadow under the base, specular energy kept on the ribbon and not on the bottle
shots.background: apricot satin drape #F1E2CB with one poured ribbon sweep and one open ring halo in amber-gold #B8813B
shots.props: one open ring halo and one poured ribbon sweep, both kept behind the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space held on the upper right 45% of the frame for copy
shots.textZone: upper right 45% carries one headline line plus one slim sub-line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product sits at a slight 3/4 hero angle, low and to the left, with one open circular ring halo in amber-gold #B8813B floating behind it and a poured ribbon sweep of the same tone curving through the mid-ground. Soft warm key from the upper left with a gentle rim along one edge and a soft contact shadow under the base. Background apricot satin drape #F1E2CB. Headline in deep cocoa #4A3220 reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with one slim sub-line in {accent_color} reading 「{callout_1}」 set into the clean upper-right zone. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space held on the upper right 45% for copy. Negative: no more than two text blocks, no dense body copy, no third claim, no invented efficacy wording beyond the supplied placeholders, no faces, no hands, no floral props, no watermark, no ring halo crossing the label.

shots.intent: 把干、糙、暗、松四种身体皮肤状态排成一行圆窗，让买家自我对号。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed from directly overhead, four equal circular apertures in one row on the board
shots.lighting: even soft top light with deliberately lowered contrast so each window reads tight, dull and dry; no drama anywhere in the row
shots.props: four circular cut-out windows, one slim arc connector in rose-gold #C99277, the product standing small at the row end
shots.whitespace: clear even margin above and below the row of windows
shots.textZone: one short label plate centred beneath each of the four circular windows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen laid out as four equal circular apertures in one row, captured as a flat lay from directly overhead on a honey matte board #E8D8BE. Each window holds a close-up of dry, dull, rough body-skin texture on a forearm, shin, elbow or knuckle only, lit in flat low-contrast top light so the surface reads tight and lacklustre. One slim arc connector in rose-gold #C99277 links the four windows and {product} stands small at the right end of the row. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Label plates in deep cocoa #4A3220 sit beneath each window reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」. The four windows plus the product occupy 40-50% of the frame with clear even margin above and below the row. Negative: no faces, no identifiable person, no clinical or medical imagery, no invented figures or measurements, no more than four labels, no watermark, no product redesign, no shadows that contradict the top light.

shots.displayName: 三栏机制与空心胶囊位
shots.intent: 用三行空心说明位承接机制解释，把可替换的事实留给后续填写。
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile of the upright product pinned to the left third
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the upper right with gentle falloff across the field and one thin highlight band along a single side of the bottle
shots.props: three empty rounded capsule slots outlined in amber-gold #B8813B, each with one hairline rule beneath it
shots.whitespace: structured right 55% of the frame reserved for three stacked rows
shots.textZone: three stacked rows on the right, each pairing one capsule slot with one short line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce mechanism screen. {product} shown in a clean 90-degree side profile, pinned to the left third of the frame and kept at the same upright scale as the rest of the set. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft directional key from the upper right with gentle falloff and one thin highlight band along a single side of the bottle. Seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6 with three empty rounded capsule slots outlined in amber-gold #B8813B stacked on the right, each carrying one short line reading 「{selling_point_2}」, 「{selling_point_3}」 and 「{selling_point_4}」. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame with the structured right 55% kept clear for the three rows. Negative: no layered skin diagrams with invented depths or counts, no laboratory or beaker props, no invented ingredient proportions, no dense body text, no more than three rows, no watermark, no mirrored or reversed product.

shots.intent: 左右同机位同裁切的两块表面状态对照，让差异自己说话而不宣称结果。
shots.camera: matched twin panels photographed straight-on eye-level with identical crop, lens and distance on both sides
shots.lighting: identical soft front-left key and identical shadow behaviour on both panels so only the surface state differs
shots.background: apricot satin drape #F1E2CB on both panels
shots.props: one hairline centre seam in amber-gold #B8813B, nothing else
shots.whitespace: tight matched crop on both panels with a narrow outer margin only
shots.textZone: one short label plate at the foot of each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen built as two matched panels with identical framing, identical crop and identical light. Left panel: a tight zoom on dry, dull, uneven body-skin surface under soft front-left light. Right panel: the same surface reading smoother and more light-reflective under exactly the same light, with {product} standing small at the outer edge of that panel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A hairline centre seam in amber-gold #B8813B divides the panels on an apricot satin drape #F1E2CB, and each panel foot carries one label plate reading 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」. Each panel holds 50-60% of its own area with only a narrow outer margin. Negative: no fabricated or exaggerated results, no dates or time spans, no measurements or counts, no retouched plastic skin, no differing light between the two panels, no faces, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把产品放进沐浴后的真实梳妆时刻，让买家代入而不是听宣称。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel over a dressing table
shots.lighting: soft warm window light from the right near 3200K with a warm bounce card, long gentle shadow falling to the left, no cool spill
shots.background: honey surface board #E8D8BE against a warm ivory wall #FAF3E6 in a softly lit room corner
shots.props: one rolled bath mat and one small potted eucalyptus sprig at the far edge, never covering the product
shots.whitespace: soft out-of-focus room breathing space above the table line
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} standing on a honey surface board #E8D8BE in a softly lit dressing corner against a warm ivory wall #FAF3E6, with one rolled bath mat and one small potted eucalyptus sprig at the far edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, frame a little off-centre. Soft warm window light from the right near 3200K with a warm bounce, long gentle shadow to the left and no cool spill. A generic adult forearm and hand only, cropped below the shoulders, rests near the product so no face is ever in frame. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with soft out-of-focus breathing space above the table line. Negative: no identifiable face, no deformed or extra fingers, no plastic wet-look skin, no clutter covering the product, no mirror reflection of a person, no extra text, no watermark, no mismatched shadow directions.

shots.intent: 围绕泵瓶排六枚空心圆环徽标位，把四项可替换卖点挂进结构里。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down on the standing product with the dispenser collar as the focus point
shots.lighting: even warm top key with one skimming accent across the collar so the metal reads brushed rather than mirrored
shots.props: six hollow single-weight ring outlines in rose-gold #C99277, three on each side, each with one short label slot
shots.whitespace: symmetrical side gutters kept clear so the six rings read as one family
shots.textZone: six ring slots arranged three left and three right, four of them carrying short labels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce feature-array screen. {product} shown from a high 45-degree angle looking down, a close-up on the dispenser collar and shoulder as the focus point, the rest of the body falling slightly soft. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even warm top key with one skimming accent across the collar so the metal reads brushed rather than mirrored. Background apricot satin drape #F1E2CB with six hollow single-weight ring outlines in rose-gold #C99277, three on each side, four rings carrying one short label each reading 「{selling_point_5}」 plus three further supplied label slots. The product occupies 55-60% of the frame with symmetrical side gutters kept clear. Negative: no filled pictogram icons, no award or medal shapes, no check-mark shields, no certification marks, no more than four labels, no readable small print, no watermark, no duplicated product.

shots.intent: 用极低角度微距把泵头结构与膏体质地当成质量证据。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a very low angle looking upward at the dispenser collar and nozzle
shots.lighting: one skimming accent from the left raising micro-relief, a single narrow specular line along the metal, warm fill from below, shallow depth of field with the nozzle edge sharp
shots.background: honey board #E8D8BE dissolving into soft out-of-focus
shots.props: a single ribbon of dispensed lotion resting on the board beside the product
shots.whitespace: minimal margin, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, photographed from a very low angle looking upward at the dispenser collar and nozzle, with a single ribbon of dispensed lotion lying on the board beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One skimming accent from the left raising micro-relief, a single narrow specular line along the metal, warm fill from below, shallow depth of field with the nozzle edge sharp and the background dissolving into soft out-of-focus honey board #E8D8BE. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal margin. Negative: no blurry subject, no muddy or duplicated speculars, no invented splash or droplet spray, no hands, no floating parts, no readable small print, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 细金线方框里的六格多角度图鉴，一次性交代正背与开盖状态。
shots.camera: flat lay from directly overhead across a six-cell keyline grid, one product state per cell
shots.lighting: even high-key flat light in every cell with the same key direction in all six so no cell drifts
shots.background: seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6 with thin amber-gold #B8813B cell borders
shots.whitespace: even gutter between cells so the grid reads as one plate
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce gallery plate: a six-cell keyline grid captured as a flat lay from directly overhead on a seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6, cells separated by thin amber-gold #B8813B borders and an even gutter. Each cell frames one close-up state of {product}: the front face, the reverse, the dispenser with its cap lifted away, the base rim, the shoulder curve, and the product set next to its carton. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat light with the same key direction in every cell so no cell drifts, and a soft contact shadow under each unit. The six cells together occupy 60-70% of the plate. Negative: no mixed lighting between cells, no duplicated product inside one cell, no readable reverse-label copy, no batch codes or dates, no captions, no watermark, no warped straight lines in the borders.

shots.displayName: 空白参数行与空心凭证框
shots.intent: 用五条空白参数行与一枚空心印章框承载真实凭证，杜绝编造资质。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product standing at the left edge of a ruled information block
shots.lighting: clean even high-key, flat and readable, with no dramatic falloff and one soft contact shadow
shots.background: apricot satin field #F1E2CB with hairline rules in amber-gold #B8813B
shots.props: five empty ruled parameter rows, one blank seal frame with a notched edge, one blank ribbon header strip
shots.whitespace: generous left-aligned column space kept clear for supplied facts
shots.textZone: left column of five ruled rows plus one blank seal frame at the foot of the block
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen. {product} standing at the left edge of a ruled information block, shown straight-on eye-level. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Clean even high-key light, flat and readable, with one soft contact shadow under the base. Background apricot satin field #F1E2CB with hairline rules in amber-gold #B8813B forming five empty parameter rows and one blank seal frame with a notched edge at the foot of the block, plus a blank ribbon header strip across the top; two of the rows carry short captions reading 「{callout_7}」 and 「{callout_8}」. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, filing numbers, laboratory results, awards, origins, capacities or ratings; no official-looking emblems, no lettered seals, no signatures or stamps, no dense paragraphs, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以深棕缎带横幅与一枚空按钮位收口，把行动号召留给可替换文案。
shots.camera: product on a low riser photographed from a very low angle looking upward, carton set back at the same scale
shots.lighting: warm key from the upper left with a deep falloff into the brown band, thin rim light along one edge, controlled soft contact shadow on the riser
shots.background: deep cocoa band #4A3220 with one poured ribbon sweep of amber-gold #B8813B across the lower third
shots.props: one low cocoa riser block and one empty pill-shaped action plate
shots.whitespace: clear band above the product for one headline line and clear space below for the action plate
shots.textZone: one headline line above the product and one empty pill-shaped action plate below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close. {product} standing on a low cocoa riser block, photographed from a very low angle looking upward, its carton set back at the same scale so nothing overlaps the label. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm key from the upper left with a deep falloff into the background, a thin rim light along one edge and a controlled soft contact shadow on the riser. Background deep cocoa band #4A3220 with one poured ribbon sweep of amber-gold #B8813B across the lower third. One headline line in {accent_color} reading 「{selling_point_1}」 sits in the clear band above the product, and one empty pill-shaped action plate reading 「{callout_9}」 sits below it. The group occupies 55-60% of the frame. Negative: no real prices or discount figures, no countdown timers, no coupon or gift graphics, no QR codes, no membership badges, no star ratings, no platform or store wording, no watermark, no invented claims.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实（12 屏切片，已合并重复角色并丢弃无信息装饰横幅，最终 11 镜）：第 1 屏为暖象牙底上的泵瓶与外盒并立主视觉，背景一圈金色环辉与倾倒出的金色缎带，配两朵小花与两行中文标题；第 2 屏是四枚圆形皮肤状态小窗排在米色底上，下方一条深琥珀横幅加一枚球状器物，再下为三栏原因说明与左侧立瓶；第 3 屏把六种肌肤问题做成六个圆形小窗并用玫红弧线箭头串联，中央中文大标题，底部金色液滴；第 4 屏为模特侧脸与金色乳液飞溅中的斜置泵瓶，下半为围绕泵瓶排布的四枚空心圆环徽标；第 5 屏续两枚圆环共六枚，下半为绿叶背景中模特闭眼抚脸的使用场景；第 6 屏为品牌横幅加市场地理饼图与各区域标签，下半为成分故事与波浪边水果照片；第 7 屏为成分要点与波浪边油脂照片，下半为产品信息参数栏与立瓶；第 8 屏为细金线方框里的正立产品图鉴；第 9 屏为六格细线方框多角度图鉴；第 10 屏为四格泵头瓶底背标微距加金色品牌故事横幅与创始人照片；第 11 屏为奖杯图与两张证照扫描件；第 12 屏为售后条款图标行、发货说明行、星条评价与二维码与会员角标。品类判定依据（以图为准，夹名不成立）：参数区品名写明为身体用润体乳，使用方法写明淋浴或洗澡后用于全身，适用肤质为全部肤质，实物为泵头瓶配立式外盒且量级属身体护理中容量，画面涂抹对象是身体与四肢皮肤而非面部，也无任何着色、定妆、卸妆属性，故落 护肤个护 / 身体护理；无婴幼儿专属证据（成人向文案与模特、无喂养孕产寝居线索）故不改判 母婴，无批准文号、无器械或营养补充证据故不改判 医药保健。已剥离内容：原品牌中英文字标与系列名与英文标语、创始人正面肖像与奖杯、两张证照扫描件与红色印章、市场地理饼图与各区域占比、成分含量数值与成分功效叙述、容量与产地与备案编号与批号与限期使用日期、模特面容与原文案原句、瓶身与外盒的具体美术、评分星条与二维码与会员角标、原平台与店铺与物流售后条款字样；所有数值与资质位置一律改为空白参数行、空心胶囊位、空心圆环徽标、空心印章框与空按钮位，屏幕式读数一律不出现。与同中类近似的护手霜套和两款防晒套的可见差异（逐条）：一、色板与色温由灰白展台加浅沙与棕金，改为本套独有的象牙暖白、蜜杏缎面、蜜色台面加琥珀鎏金与玫瑰金，色温取暖，而该中类现有两套为冷调一套为中性；二、背景体系改为缎面垂坠加倾倒鎏金缎带与空心环辉、并以细金线方框图鉴为版式骨架，近似套用的是几何立体展台、渐变面板与冷暖分栏；三、道具改为四枚圆形肌理窗、六枚空心圆环徽标阵、三行空心胶囊位、五条空白参数行与空心印章框、卷起的地垫加一盆桉树枝，近似套道具为金色线框条、折叠毛巾与小瓷盘、冰块与圆镜与球体；四、机位体系新增极低压角微距与平铺六格图鉴与高角度俯拍圆窗阵，近似套以平视与轻微俯拍为主且无仰角微距；五、角色序列改为双镜开加痛点、机制、对照、场景、三镜细节、空白信任、暖棕收口的十一镜，护手霜套仅八镜且止于信任屏、无收口亦无图鉴格；六、自禁项额外锁定不得出现冷灰蓝偏色、不得出现填充式图标与奖章印章美术、不得改变立瓶尺度与外盒方位，近似套的自禁项未涉及这三条。另与面部护理内暖金色与香槟金色近调套区分：本套不出现片状膜体、贝壳沙面、凝露滴片与刀裁边框，主视觉语言只保留身体护理的鎏金缎带、细金线图鉴与空心圆环。全篇不含任何成分含量、功效断言、检测与认证、销量与评分、规格数值等平台或源页事实。
